rules: Amounts are integer pesos. null means the version has no such line, never zero.
The NEP and the House bill are two versions of one budget: compare them, never add them. Sums over a filtered set are given per version and marked not_additive_across_versions.

Pairings are candidates: leads for checking, not confirmed changes. A line found in one version only is an insertion candidate (House bill only) or a deletion candidate (NEP only), never a confirmed insertion or deletion.

Unconfirmed matches (held: fuzzy or ambiguous pairings) are flagged on every row. Bridge figures are the stored ones the pages show: they include unconfirmed matches (fuzzy or ambiguous pairings, counted under 'In the House bill only'), so the six groups add up to net_php. Each group's unconfirmed_rows / unconfirmed_php is the unconfirmed part of it (non-zero only on DPWH house_only). php is the group's money basis: the House amount for house_only and unchanged, the NEP amount for nep_only, the size of the movement for increased and decreased, and the signed net for scope_review. The largest-rows lists leave unconfirmed matches out.

District figures carry their tier. A shared (Tier B) office's money is never divided between the districts it serves, and money under the DPWH Central Office and regional offices, which is on no district card, is returned as the residual.
Rows with a page on the site carry url; document page references carry pdf_url, which opens the source PDF at that page.

Every response carries disclaimers (id, title, body, url): the no-allegations paragraph everywhere, and the office-and-district paragraph as well on office-based views (the district routes and DPWH project lists filtered to one office). Keep them with any figure you republish.

nep.meaning: National Expenditure Program: the budget the President submits to Congress each August.

hgab.meaning: The House of Representatives' version of the budget, House Bill 10858 for 2027. It goes to the Senate next.

reading.meaning: The House votes on a bill twice. The third-reading text is the version it sends to the Senate.

pap.meaning: A heading in the budget under which projects are listed, for example 'Preventive Maintenance - Primary Roads'.

deo.meaning: The DPWH field office that carries out projects in an area. One office can serve more than one congressional district.

fap.meaning: A project paid for partly with a loan or grant from abroad.

candidate.meaning: A match or a gap found by comparing project names, places and amounts. It is a lead for checking, not a confirmed change.

tier.meaning: Tier A: the office serves one district, so its figure can be read as that district’s. Tier B: the office serves several districts, so the figure is shared and is not split between them.

residual.meaning: Money listed under the DPWH Central Office or a regional office. It does not appear on any district card.

stages.meaning: The NEP and the House bill are two versions of the same budget. Compare them; never add them together.

glossary.fil: Ang National Expenditure Program o NEP ay panukalang pambansang budget na isinusumite ng Pangulo sa Kongreso. Panukala pa ito, hindi pa ang batas na budget at hindi tala ng nagastos.
glossary.en: The National Expenditure Program (NEP) is the national budget proposed by the President to Congress. It is a proposal, not the enacted budget or a record of spending.

glossary.fil: Ang House bill ay bersiyon ng panukalang budget mula sa Kapulungan ng mga Kinatawan. Sa tala para sa 2027, ito ang House Bill 10858. Ikatlong pagbasa ang gamit sa paghahambing ng DPWH; ikalawang pagbasa sa tatlong iba pang programa, na may magkaparehong listahan sa dalawang pagbasa. Hindi pa ito ang General Appropriations Act.
glossary.en: The House bill is the House of Representatives' version of the proposed budget: House Bill 10858 in the 2027 dataset. DPWH comparisons use third reading; the other three programs use second reading, with identical lists at both readings. It is not yet the General Appropriations Act.

glossary.fil: Ang General Appropriations Act o GAA ay batas na naglalaan ng pondong maaaring gastusin. Ang mga tala rito para sa 2020 hanggang 2026 ay mga halagang inilaan sa batas, hindi patunay ng aktuwal na paggastos. Isang pamilya ng programa ang iisang pangalan sa iisang ahensiya sa iba't ibang taon; ibang pamilya ang pinalitang pangalan.
glossary.en: The General Appropriations Act (GAA) is the law authorizing budget appropriations. The 2020–2026 records show enacted amounts, not proof of actual spending. A program family groups the same name in the same agency across years; a renamed program is a different family.

glossary.fil: Ang halagang inilaan sa budget ay hindi awtomatikong halagang nagastos. Hindi ipinapakita ng tala kung tapos na ang proyekto. Ang makikita rito ay ang halagang nakalista sa dokumento ng budget. Kailangan ng hiwalay na tala para malaman ang aktuwal na paggastos o pagkumpleto.
glossary.en: An amount appropriated in a budget is not automatically money spent. These records do not establish whether a project is complete. They show amounts listed in budget documents; actual spending and completion require separate evidence.

glossary.fil: Ang 'House bill only' at 'NEP only' ay mga kandidatong dapat suriin, hindi kumpirmadong pagdagdag o pagtanggal. Maaaring napalitan ang pangalan o saklaw. Ang 'unconfirmed match' ay hindi pa tiyak na pagtutugma. Ang mas mataas, mas mababa, o kaparehong halaga ay paghahambing ng mga tala, hindi patunay ng iregularidad. Sa 'scope review', magkaiba ang bahaging sakop kaya hindi direktang maihahambing ang halaga.
glossary.en: 'House bill only' and 'NEP only' are candidates for review, not confirmed insertions or deletions; names or scope may have changed. An unconfirmed match is a provisional pairing. Higher, lower, or unchanged amounts compare records and do not prove wrongdoing. Scope-review records cover different stretches and are not directly comparable.

glossary.term: Separate versions, missing values and zero
glossary.fil: Magkaibang bersiyon ng iisang budget ang NEP at House bill: ihambing, huwag pagsamahin. Ang nawawalang halaga ay hindi zero at hindi patunay na walang proyekto. Sa GAA, ituring lamang na may pondong inilaan sa isang taon kapag higit sa zero ang halaga; hindi sapat ang bilang ng mga linyang may pangalan. Panatilihing magkahiwalay ang mga taon.
glossary.en: NEP and House amounts are versions of one budget: compare them, never add them. A missing amount is not zero or proof that no project exists. A GAA year counts as funded only when its amount is above zero, not merely because a line count is present. Keep fiscal years separate.

glossary.fil: Mga pambansang tala ng budget na tumutugma sa paghahanap na 'Antipolo City' ang saklaw nito, hindi ang buong budget ng Antipolo City Hall. Sa 2027, pinananatili ang Region IV-A at mga talang walang rehiyon. Walang filter ng rehiyon ang GAA. Paghahanap ito batay sa pangalan, hindi kumpletong pagsusuri ng lahat ng proyektong pisikal na nasa lungsod.
glossary.en: Coverage is national budget records matching the search 'Antipolo City', not the complete Antipolo City Hall budget. The 2027 scope keeps Region IV-A and records without a region. GAA has no region filter. This is a name-based search, not a survey of every project physically in the city.
